13183.d: A Harvest Festival plant can be grown from Harvest Festival seeds. • All players can prune it to burn the rotten produce, yielding greater Firemaking experience for the owner and one tenth of that for others. • Additionally, the plant owner can harvest it for Harvest Festival produce or, more rarely, Harvest Festival perfect produce. • Subsequently, the owner may offer the produce to the gods for Prayer experience; or • The owner may return the produce to the earth for Farming experience.
13183.ex: This grows Harvest Festival produce which can be converted into Farming or Prayer experience. It will also grow rotten produce which can be burned for Firemaking XP.

13184.d: The Harvest Hollow (full name the Land of Harvest's Harvest Hollow) is a seasonal hub for Halloween events since the 2024 Halloween event.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Casting Harvest Hollow Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network
• Teleporting with the Harvest Hollow entry in the Calendar or Community events interface
• Entering the Harvest Hollow portal in the northern Grand Exchange
• Entering the Holiday portal in Prifddinas
• Teleporting with town criers
